guidance.fixed_rotation: Fixed Rotation Seettu: Members take turns in a predetermined rotational order to receive the standard pooled lump-sum.
guidance.auction: Auction / Bidding Seettu: Members submit competitive discount bids for early pot access. The discount is redistributed as monthly dividends to reduce other subscribers' installments.
guidance.random_draw: Random Draw / Lottery: Neutral algorithmic lot selection chooses the winning payout recipient fairly each cycle from eligible non-prizewinners.
guidance.non_monetary: Non-Monetary Asset Seettu: Rotating savings pool for tangible high-value physical goods (jewelry, electronics, machinery) backed by a registered partner merchant shop.

landing.slide_0_title: Traditional Community Savings, Powered by Digital Trust
landing.slide_0_sub: Digitize your village or neighborhood Seettu (සීට්ටු / சீட்டு) circle with transparent contribution logs, automated rotation cycles, and mutual financial discipline.
landing.slide_1_title: Automated Record-Keeping for Sri Lankan Savings Groups
landing.slide_1_sub: Eliminate forgotten payments and handwritten notebook disputes. Manage cash handovers, bank slip verifications, and scheduled lump-sum payouts seamlessly.
landing.slide_2_tag: TRADITIONAL GOLD SEETTU (රන් සීට්ටු / தங்கச் சீட்டு)
landing.slide_2_title: Preserve Family Wealth with Traditional Gold Rotations
landing.slide_2_sub: Organize high-value rotation pools for sovereign gold jewelry, farming equipment, and vehicles with verified item valuation.
landing.slide_3_title: Build Community Trust with Tamper-Proof Discipline Scores
landing.slide_3_sub: On-time monthly contributions award recognized discipline scores and unlock verified completion certificates for all group members.
landing.how_sub: Four simple steps from enrollment to guaranteed rotation payout
landing.step_1_desc: Choose monthly contribution, member size, and Seettu type (Fixed queue, Auction bidding, Lottery draw, or Gold).
landing.step_2_desc: Every member is verified with Sri Lankan NIC and optional Grama Niladhari certificate for mutual trust.
landing.step_3_desc: Transfer via online banking or cash to organizer. Real-time digital ledger updates instantly.
landing.step_4_desc: Collect the full pooled sum on your rotation cycle, complete with verified completion certificates.
landing.legal_banner_title: Governed by The Cheetus Ordinance No. 61 of 1935
landing.legal_banner_desc: Sri Lanka's recognized statutory framework for rotating savings. Every group maintains digital bylaws, audit trails, and formal default remediation procedures.
